messages:
maria: Noticing a spike of preempt evictions and Pending tiny pods in us-west2 this morning. One rack looks super fragmented, warmpool scale is lagging and node logs show conntrack quota warnings.

alex: Any recent node label/taint rollout that could explain packing shifts?

maria: Infra rolled node-label v2 last night (node.k8s.redwood/zone=weighted) and autoscaler probe timeout was decreased to 6s.

ryan: Scheduler shows repeated backfill failures and conntrack errors: ```
E0903 09:12:33 scheduling failed: conntrack quota exceeded
E0903 09:12:34 backfill retry: node egress qlen high
```

jun: Can we pause the label rollout in one AZ and revert canary to compare?

alex: I can pause if we have counts. @maria share pending and pod size distribution?

maria: Pending total 124 across 3 racks. Breakdown: tiny (<=0.25 GPU)=87, small (0.5)=25, medium (1)=12. Unit-cost hit estimated +40% vGPU-hours due to poor co-location.

laura: Warmpool.handoff.success metric dropped ~30% in the same window. Dash link: http://dash/reports/waffle?run=62143

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-62143; paging oncall-sre.

maria: Did a canary: relaxed anti-affinity on tiny runners. Patch: ```kubectl patch deploy tiny-runner -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":null}}}}'``` Pending dropped ~60% in that canary AZ. :relieved:

ryan: Short-term: bump conntrack on nodes and throttle the label rollout. Medium-term: autoscaler probe timeout revert + investigate probe flakiness.

alex: Rolling back label rollout in us-west2a now. Monitoring.

jun: I'll open a scheduler PR to prefer homogeneous binpacking for tiny/small pods and include NIC/egress awareness. Will add tests.

laura: Requesting new telemetry: per-node small_pod_count gauge and a heatmap in packer dashboard so this shows up earlier.

maria: If rollback + warmpool fixes don't hold we'll ask capacity-ops to shift some burst capacity between AZs temporarily. @ops keep an eye on eviction rates.

ops: Watching. Set alert: evictions.pods.rate > 10/min -> notify #eng-platform + oncall.

sre-bot: Rollback completed in us-west2a at 09:35 UTC.

maria: Verified pending dropped to 38 and eviction rate ~50% lower. Keeping thread open for 2h to watch. :thumbsup:
